big_case.notes: Pro se petition by a physician contesting a California medical-license revocation, reaching the Court from a Court of Appeal dismissal for a record deficiency and a California Supreme Court denial of review. The questions presented ask in general terms whether the Court may intervene; no split, no construed statute, no federal party, no amicus, no response called for. Denied without comment on the first conference after the long conference. Stakes are personal to the petitioner.
